title: Spicy Keto-Caramelized Meringue Feast
description: A cozy Saudi Arabian dish featuring spicy meringue nests caramelized to perfection, perfect for a dessert or snack.

ingredients.name: Pumpkin Puree (optional for added flavor, keto-friendly)

instructions: Beat the eggs in a mixing bowl until frothy.
Add heavy cream, cinnamon powder, spicy peppercorns, and sweetener. Beat on medium speed until stiff peaks form.
Fold in pumpkin puree if using.
Place meringue nests on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or silicone mat.
Sprinkle cayenne pepper evenly over the tops of the meringue nests and gently press it in with your fingers for added spiciness.
Bake for 15 minutes, then reduce oven temperature to 170°C (338°F) and continue baking for another 20-25 minutes or until golden brown on top and firm inside.
Allow meringue nests to cool before serving.
